title: Aeroponic Farming: Efficient and Nutritious Crops
reason: This video describes various benefits of aeroponic farming compared to traditional soil-based methods.

tasks.task: Explain the benefits of aeroponic farming.

subtasks.text: Distinguish between the 160 crops that can be grown aeroponically and soil-based crops.
